remarks: Welcome to in-town luxury living at 424 South Avenue! This custom residence blends timeless elegance with contemporary comfort and sophistication. The stunning kitchen steals the show with oversized island and high-end appliances, a culinary enthusiast's dream. The open layout flows effortlessly into the light-filled breakfast area and gorgeous family room, an inviting space for gatherings and relaxation. Stunning library offers a cozy fireplace and custom cabinetry. Six bedrooms and 6 1/2 baths spread across 4 meticulously designed floors, every inch of this home exudes luxury and comfort. The beautiful private backyard provides the perfect canvas for outdoor relaxation, promising endless hours of enjoyment and tranquility. Elevator-ready and prosposed pool site on file! Don't miss the opportunity to make this exceptional residence your own!
